$Comment: Old Jack's Favor: the name, picture and limits of the game's reputation group of the same id
Gear names the stat whose Max equipped items add on top of what a player has earned; the Jack
Helm adds to it. Cap is the most favor earning can reach: Exalted's floor, so Jack's Own is as
far as it goes. Ranks renames the library's ranks for Old Jack alone; a rank left out keeps the
library's name. Order places him on the Reputation page. Favor comes from the Reputation rewards
on his quests and board contracts and from his daily board line.
